concept_granularity.merge_rule: Merge only explicit synonyms and abbreviations that name the same source concept.
concept_granularity.separation_rule: Keep clinically or administratively non-equivalent concepts separate even when related.

entry_contract.aliases: Every alias must occur in the selected source text for the same split and be unique after normalization.
entry_contract.definition: State the source concept in plain language without encoding a criterion decision.
entry_contract.field_id: Use stable lower snake case naming that identifies only the concept.
entry_contract.prohibited_content: Field IDs, definitions, and aliases must not encode criterion-specific thresholds, units, time windows, negation, value types, polarity, operators, or tree structure.

failure_policy.unseen_concept: Stop the affected split; create an owner-reviewed catalog version and fresh annotations and predictions for that split.
failure_policy.unresolved_catalog_entry: Do not freeze the catalog until the owner resolves the entry without model output.

source_boundary.allowed_source: Only selected criterion source text from the catalog's own split.

split_timeline.dev: Author and freeze from dev source text before dev annotation.
split_timeline.test: Do not inspect or author the test catalog until the exact model, prompt, runtime, and decoding configuration are frozen; then freeze it before test annotation and inference.
